_doc: Living world stage 2 (docs/LIVING_WORLD.md): recruiting companions and giving them orders, masters' lessons, errands. Same format as core.json. Extra conditions: companion, companion_mode, refusal (none, no_fighter, wanted, taken, crowded, hostile, stranger, town_danger, students, duty, afraid, proud), lesson (none, practice, test), lesson_refusal (none, not_master, wanted, stranger, nothing), errand (none, offer, mine, ready, full), traveler. Extra actions: recruit, command:<follow|wait|defend|passive|aggressive|home>, dismiss, lesson_start, lesson_test, lesson_quit, errand_accept, errand_turn_in, errand_abandon. Extra placeholders: {lesson}, {errand}, {errand_progress}, {reward}.

text: Travel with you? I'd be glad to. Where are we headed?
I was hoping you'd ask. Lead the way.
The road's better with company. I'm in.
Ha! I was about to move on anyway. Let's go together.
Really? With you? I'll learn more in a week out there than a year in the dojo!
Me? I'm no fighter. I'd only slow you down.
Ha! I can barely lift a sack of rice. Find someone who can fight.
After what you did here? Never.
I already travel with someone. I don't break my word.
You've got enough company already, don't you think?
Travel with you? I'd sooner fight you.
You must be joking.
I barely know you. Come back when I do.
Hm. Help out around here a little first, and we'll see.
Not while {town} is in danger!
My students need me here. Perhaps one day, when they are ready to stand without me.
My post is here. Earn {town}'s trust first, then ask me again.
Out there? With the kind of fights you get into? No thank you.
Follow someone weaker than me? Come back when you can beat me.
Ha! You'd need me more than I'd need you.
What do you need?
I'm listening.
Still waiting right here, like you said.
Ready to head out again?
Back for me? Good, I was getting restless.
Still keeping my head down. What now?
Right.
Right behind you.
Lead the way.
I'll wait here.
I won't move from this spot.
Nobody touches you while I'm around.
I've got your back.
Let's show them what we've got!
Finally, some real fighting!
I'll keep my head down.
Fine, I'll stay out of it.
I'll be at home. Come find me when you need me.
I'll head back. You know where I live.

say: You want to go our separate ways?

text: It was good traveling with you, {player}.
Take care out there. You know where to find me.
{lesson}? Very well. Watch closely, I will show it once.
So you want to learn {lesson}. Good. Watch.
{lesson}. Breathe, and watch my hands.

say: The power comes from your center, not your hands. Now gather your ki here, beside me, and hold it steady until I say.

text: Keep gathering your ki near me. Steady... steady.
Not yet. Charge your ki beside me and hold it.
Your control is good. Now prove it in a real spar with me. Ready?
One thing left: face me. Show me {lesson} has a place in your fighting.

options.text: I'd like to stop this lesson.

text: Train you? Show me first that you can listen. Spar with my students, come back often, and we'll see.
I don't take students lightly. Prove your commitment.
I have taught you all I can, or all you can use. The rest you must find on your own road.
There is nothing more I can show you. Go on, you have outgrown this dojo.
I don't teach strangers. Help this town, spar with my students, and come back.
Earn my trust first. Then we'll talk about lessons.
Actually, yes. {errand} There are {reward} training points in it for you.
Now that you mention it... {errand} I can give you {reward} training points for it.
Thank you! Come back to me when it's done.
You're a lifesaver. Let me know when it's done.
How's it going? Remember: {errand} ({errand_progress} so far)
Any luck? {errand_progress} so far.
You did it? Thank you!
Done already? I knew I could count on you.

options.text: I can't do it after all.

text: You're a good sort, {player}. Here, as promised.
As promised. {town} owes you one.
Oh. Well... I understand.
That's a shame. Never mind, then.
My students need a real opponent. Spar with {count} of them for me.
My students grow lazy against each other. Spar with {count} of them.
Would you train with me? Just one spar. I want to see how far I am from someone like you.
Spar with me! Please? I won't get better fighting the same people every day.
There's a fighter called {target} about, not far from {town}. Deal with them before they come here.
Word is {target} has been seen near here. Stop them, and {town} sleeps easier.
Monsters have been prowling round {town} at night. Thin them out: {count} should do.
Something keeps coming at the walls after dark. Put down {count} of those monsters for me.
Could you take a message to {target}{town2}? Tell them I've been thinking of them.
Would you see {target}{town2} for me? Just tell them I said hello. They'll know.
I'm short of {item}. Could you bring me {count}?
Could you find me {count} {item}? I'm all out.
{target} and I... we haven't been getting along. Would you talk to them for me?
I've fallen out with {target}. I'm too proud to go myself. Would you talk to them?
They say {target} is out there, around {x}, {z}. Go and see it for me, and tell me what it's like!
I've always wanted to see {target}. It's around {x}, {z}. Go, and tell me everything!
All right, let's see what you've got!
Don't hold back!
Here I come!
Show me. Everything.
Begin.
You picked the wrong town to attack!
Leave {town} alone!
Not one step further!
In the name of {town}: stand down!
You're done here.
You will regret raising your hand in my town.
Students, behind me.
For the dojo!
{master}, watch this!
